title: Prose Status: says planejado while frontmatter, index and evidence all say pousado (specs 0001 and 0002)
reply_prose: Confirmed on the promoted head de0878a5, and it affects both specs: 0001 line 25 and 0002 line 26 still read **Status:** planejado while the frontmatter status:, the docs/specs/README.md table and the Evidence column all say pousado. Doc-only prose drift with no runtime effect, so it is not merge-blocking, but it is real and the fix is two lines.

title: Dark-theme token block duplicated between the prefers-color-scheme media query and [data-thm=dark] without a sync note
reply_prose: The duplication is real: lines 139-181 repeat lines 93-136 value for value, because the same dark palette has to be reachable through two different triggers (the OS preference and the manual toggle) and CSS custom properties give no way to share one declaration across both selectors without a third indirection. The proposed fix is a comment, not a change in behaviour, so this is a nitpick rather than a defect. Recorded, not applied in this promotion.
